lines.text: Many learners say: The woman which lives next door is a doctor.
Better: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.
Who! The man who called you is my uncle.

quiz.stem: The man ___ called you is my uncle.

native.tip: О человеке говорим “who”: “The woman who lives next door is a doctor.”
native.caption: Ты тоже говоришь “The woman which lives next door is a doctor”? 😅 По-русски «которая» подходит и для людей, и для вещей, поэтому рука тянется к “which”, но о человеке нужно “who.” Правильно: “The woman who lives next door is a doctor.” Послушай Карлоса и повтори! Больше практики — в приложении Lexkite.
native.comment: Ответ: “who.” О человеке — who. Напиши своё предложение с “The man who.” Бесплатный тест для практики здесь: {link}

en.tip: For a person, use “who”: “The woman who lives next door is a doctor.”
en.caption: Do you also say “The woman which lives next door is a doctor”? 😅 In Russian one word covers people and things, so “which” feels fine, but for a person you need “who.” Correct: “The woman who lives next door is a doctor.” Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
